GOLFPRICE AI: PHOTO LIBRARY PROMPT PACK (for ChatGPT, free)
==========================================================
These photos are the backgrounds for our two new post styles (A: golf humour, B: big headline).
Our engine adds all the words, banners and arrows itself, so the photos must have NO TEXT.

HOW TO USE
1. Paste the MASTER STYLE below into ChatGPT once, then ask for each scene one at a time:
   "Using the master style, make scene 7".
2. Ask for PORTRAIT 1024 x 1536 (it crops to 9:16 and 4:5 nicely).
3. Save each as scene-NN.png (01 to 30, matching the list) and send them to Claude in the chat,
   a few at a time is fine. Claude checks each one, tags it and adds it to the library.
4. If a face looks odd, hands look wrong, or any text or logo appears, just ask ChatGPT to redo it.

MASTER STYLE (paste first)
--------------------------
Photorealistic, premium golf-lifestyle photograph for social media, portrait 1024 x 1536.
Natural daylight on a UK golf course (parkland, links or heathland), rich natural greens, shallow
depth of field, crisp detail, true-to-life skin. The people are fictional everyday amateur golfers
(not models, not anyone famous), aged 25 to 60, a mix of men and women, expressive and funny but
believable. Classic golf clothing in plain colours (navy, grey, olive, cream, white).
Composition: keep the top 20% and the bottom 25% of the frame calmer (sky, grass, soft blur) so
headlines can sit there; the main subject sits in the middle. Nothing important within 5% of the edges.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, words, numbers, logos, brand names, watermarks or lettering anywhere: not on
clothing, caps, gloves, balls, bags, clubs, signs or screens. No illustration or cartoon style,
no over-saturated HDR.

THE 30 SCENES
-------------
Humour (Style A)
01 Golfer crouched on the green, hands on head, ball stopped one inch from the hole.
02 Golfer lying flat on the green at eye level with a ball on the lip of the cup, pained grin.
03 Golfer in a deep bunker, only head and club visible, sand flying, resigned face.
04 Golfer peering into thick rough with a club, clearly lost the ball, mates laughing behind.
05 Golfer standing at the edge of a pond staring at ripples where the ball went in.
06 Four golfers under one umbrella in sideways rain, soaked but laughing.
07 Golfer mid-swing on the tee, face scrunched, divot flying higher than the ball.
08 Golfer proudly holding a shiny new driver, partner behind with arms folded, eyebrow raised.
09 Golfer secretly hiding a new golf bag behind the car boot in a car park, looking over shoulder.
10 Golfer counting strokes on fingers with a doubtful face while a playing partner stares.
11 Golfer celebrating wildly with arms up, ball clearly still short of the hole.
12 Golfer frozen over a short putt, sweat on brow, mates in the background holding their breath.
13 Golfer looking up into a tree, ball stuck on a branch.
14 Golfer at the 19th hole (clubhouse bar, no signs) telling a story with big hand gestures, friends unimpressed.
15 Golfer on a frosty winter morning, breath visible, wearing every layer they own.

Big headline (Style B)
16 Close-up of a golf ball on a tee at sunrise, dew on the grass, driver head soft-focus behind.
17 Golf bag full of clubs standing on a fairway at golden hour.
18 Overhead flat-lay of golf gear on grass: balls, glove, tees, rangefinder (all plain, no logos).
19 Pristine green with a flag at sunset, long shadows.
20 Golfer's hands holding a smartphone on the course (screen a soft blank glow).
21 Driver head close-up resting on the grass, shallow depth of field.
22 Three golf balls in a row on a putting green, one slightly ahead.
23 Empty misty fairway at dawn, a single golfer walking away with a trolley.
24 Electric golf trolley parked by a tee box, autumn trees behind.
25 Golf shoes and glove on a wooden bench in a locker room, morning light.
26 A ball sitting in a perfect fairway lie, low angle, the green far away.
27 Rangefinder held up to the eye, flag soft-focus in the distance.
28 A bucket of range balls on a driving range mat, dusk lights coming on.
29 Golf gloves and a scorecard-shaped blank card on a bench (no writing).
30 Snow-dusted golf course with a flag, crisp blue sky.

When these are in, Claude will also give you a short "top-up" pack each month so the feed never
reuses the same photos (the agents won't use any photo twice within 20 posts).
